title: The Body Renews Its Stomach Lining In 5 Days, Not Every Cell
hook: Your body renews stomach lining in 5 days, but other cells last decades.
closing: The body has many renewal schedules; a fast-changing surface does not mean every cell is newly replaced.
question: Which tissue's renewal surprised you most?

segments.say: The stomach lining renews in about 5 days in this comparison. Slower tissues show why the body has no single replacement date.
The cumulative series reaches 30 trillion replaced cells. Replacement adds up over the measured interval rather than happening all at once.
The skin example is 28 days old in these data. The cortical-neuron comparison is vastly older, so renewal depends on cell type.
